## Invitations

During the reporting period, invitations were issued to 2348 people. Attendance was recorded for 794 people, giving an attendance rate of 33.8. These figures provide the basis for reviewing the reach of the invitation activity and the level of participation achieved. The attendance total should be considered alongside the number invited when assessing uptake. The reported rate provides a concise measure of participation across the invitation activity.

The invitation and attendance figures are recorded as supplied for the outreach report. No additional attendance or invitation figures are included in this summary. The report was prepared by G. Evans.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 2002 invitees. Reminder messages were also sent to 2002 invitees. The matching figures indicate that the recorded SMS and reminder activity covered the same number of invitees. These contact figures are presented alongside the invitation and attendance information to support review of communication activity and participation.

The contact records are limited to the SMS and reminder totals stated above. Prepared by G. Evans.
